scope: local Docker image-generation smoke after dynamic bounded aspect-ratio normalization

normalization_fix.behavior: accept only bounded upstream aspect-ratio drift and normalize with aspect-preserving contain padding
normalization_fix.guardrails: pixel drift is capped at max(8, one-percent of the requested short edge), while relative drift remains capped at one-percent; larger mismatches remain rejected

result: The local Docker service accepts the PetDex atlas dimensions in a real request. The upstream 1024x1536 portrait result is normalized to 1536x2288 without stretching or cropping, while materially different aspect ratios remain rejected.
